name: blackfriday.tools
accepts: Offers on SaaS, AI and indie tools. Mac apps are listed. Categories include Lifetime deals and Productivity.
cost_note: 'Free listing · BFCM 2026' on the submit page.
how_to_submit: Sign in by email at https://blackfriday.tools/submit (no password), paste your URL, and the form drafts the listing; you add the discount code and the dates. No fields show before sign-in.
rules: The page says you add the discount code and the dates it runs, and that is the whole job. Whether a deal without a code passes is not stated.
Deals need an explicit end date; 'while supplies last' is not accepted.
